title: Vint Cerf is working on a plan to unleash AI agents on the open internet
slides: Vint Cerf's next project: AI agents unleashed online?
He's designing a protocol for autonomous agent communication.
No human approval needed for each agent action.
Your browser could soon host your personal agent.
Test Cerf's agent protocol with a simple script today.
thread_text:
1. Your next browser update changes everything?

Vint Cerf is building a protocol so AI agents act without your approval on each step.

2. No more asking for permission.

The protocol lets agents negotiate tasks among themselves, cutting out human delays entirely.

3. Your browser becomes a host.

Each tab could run a personal agent that books, buys, or queries on your behalf.

4. Why Cerf? He invented TCP/IP.

If he designed the internet's backbone, this agent protocol might become the new standard.

5. Test it today.

Grab a sample script from Cerf's repo and simulate two agents negotiating a purchase. No install needed.

instagram.caption:
Vint Cerf, the co-creator of the internet, is designing a new protocol so AI agents can negotiate tasks without asking you for permission every time.

No more step-by-step approvals. Agents would talk to each other, comparing prices or checking availability, and act on your behalf directly. Your browser could host one of these agents per tab.

This shifts your role from clicking confirm to setting boundaries and letting machines execute. For anyone publishing online, your content might soon be consumed by autonomous buyers, not just humans.

Would you trust an AI to book your next trip without checking in on each detail?
